name: combined_audio_video_01
notes: cam_01 originally pointed at data/clips/intrusion.mp4, a synthetic vector-graphic placeholder (not real footage) that YOLO11n never detects a person in -- same defect fixed in intrusion_01.json (see its notes for how this was verified); repointed at the same real people.mp4/zone_A used there, timed to overlap the audio event. Deliberately overlaps a video 'intrusion' event (family: security, per FusionAgent.EVENT_FAMILIES) with a real audio 'audio_glass_break' event (also family: security) in the same time window (both agents start playback at scenario t=0, so audio GT timing must match the audio FILE's own timeline, not an arbitrary offset -- glass_breaking_with_baseline.wav is 15s of baseline noise + the real glass-break at ~15-19.5s; see audio_glass_break_01.json for why the 15s lead-in is required for the DSP fallback to fire at all). FusionAgent's noisy-OR corroboration (thesis claim C3) should raise fused confidence versus either modality alone. Requires YAMNet (tensorflow_hub) to actually emit the audio_glass_break label; under the DSP fallback the audio event degrades to generic 'audio_anomaly' (family: violence_or_hazard) and will NOT corroborate -- that mismatch is itself a useful ablation data point, not a bug, so don't 'fix' it by hand-mapping families.
